title: daily-account-rundown-priya-2026-03-30
content:
Morning rundown — quick brain dump before calls. Not polished. Prioritize: AuroraHealth QBR prep, Stellar Metrics renewal check, ByteScale support follow-ups.

Top-of-day timeline
- 08:30 — triage Slack (tickets flagged by SRE overnight)
- 09:00 — prep notes for AuroraHealth QBR (see bullets below)
- 10:00 — check-in with Maya (alignment on renewal asks)
- 11:00 — 30m sync with Liam about ByteScale incident follow-ups
- 14:00 — AuroraHealth QBR (1h) — slides + ask list ready 30m early
- 16:00 — outreach batch: renewals + support follow-ups (email templates below)

Quick flags / urgent items
- AuroraHealth: data residency question popped up last night (legal looped). Need an answer about on-prem demo by EOD — ping Eng-Private (ticket CS-487).
- Stellar Metrics: renewal decision expected by 04/05 — champion changed, new exec is skeptical about cost. Need fresh usage report and SLOs.
- ByteScale: long-tail latency spikes — SRE assigned, but customer is asking for root-cause timeline. Prepare interim response.

AuroraHealth QBR prep (bullet script)
- Goal: reassure on compliance roadmap + show latency/cost improvements since GA.
- Slides to surface: 1) adoption metrics last quarter (top 5 endpoints) 2) cost delta after batching tweaks 3) audit/KMS plan for private deployment timeline 4) next steps + decision points (on-prem pilot scope, data flow, timeline)
- Ask list (what we want from them):
  - Confirm internal PI for pilot (who signs off)
  - Any legal requirements beyond SOC2/HIPAA? details due Tue
  - Permission to spin up small on-prem PoC (2 nodes) for May pilot
- Risk notes: on-prem demo needs infra budget approval — escalate to Solutions Eng if they say yes.
- To prep: pull last 90-day token usage from Console + per-route lat/err rates (Liam).

Stellar Metrics renewal play
- Owner: Maya -> follow up on price pushback.
- Quick asks: send week-over-week usage chart + cost-per-1000-tokens after quantization suggestion. Offer 2-month bridge discount conditional on committed capacity.
- Email subject idea: "Options to lower costs ahead of renewal — simple next steps"
- If they stall: propose a 2-week A/B with quantized model (metric: same prompt eval pass rate >= 92%).

ByteScale incident follow-up checklist
- What they asked: ETA for RCA, mitigation applied, plan to prevent recurrence.
- Today: gather timeline from SRE (ticket SRE-1102), compile customer-facing RCA draft, share by 15:00 PT.
- Include: temporary mitigations, long-term fix estimate, any migration guidance.

Batch outreach templates (short)
- Renewal nudge (short): "Hi <Name>, quick check — finalizing renewal options for <Product>. I can send a short usage + cost summary today and propose a simple option to reduce spend. Are you available for 15m tomorrow? — Priya"
- Support follow-up (RCA promise): "Hi <Name>, thanks for your patience. SRE has a draft RCA and mitigation plan — can I share the summary and next steps by 15:00 PT? Would you prefer a short call after that?"

Notes-to-self (random shorthands)
- Bring up the console demo showing per-route caching benefits in Aurora call — visual sells.
- Ask Eng if we have a canned demo for KMS flow (show audit log).
- Double-check Stellar Metrics contract date vs internal renewal reminder (possible off-by-one on our calendar).
- Send Maya the proposed discount calc and A/B plan before lunch.

Open questions / follow-ups to record
- Who is the new exec at Stellar? (LinkedIn showed a VP of Product — confirm exact title)
- Does Aurora still require annual on-site audits, or will online logs suffice? (Legal needed)
- ByteScale: are spikes correlated with a specific model variant? (SRE/Applied ML)

Quick links to pull before 09:30
- Console usage dashboard: (quick nav) Console > Customers > AuroraHealth > Usage (last 90 days)
- SLA / Contract: Confluence page under CS library (linked_artifacts above)
- Ticket references: CS-487 (Aurora on-prem request), SRE-1102 (ByteScale latency)

Close-out checklist for today (tick when done)
- [ ] Aurora prep doc + slides ready 30m before meeting
- [ ] Send Stellar Metrics usage + discount calc to Maya
- [ ] Draft RCA for ByteScale and share with Liam for technical sign-off
- [ ] Outreach batch sent (renewals + promised follow-ups)
- [ ] Log notes from Aurora QBR into Confluence (short summary + next steps)

End of dump. Keep short, iterate after calls. If anything blocks, escalate via #cs-escalations.

-- Priya
